evidence.observation: Growth-stage pressure 2.922 Torr, matching the ramp baseline of about 2.90 Torr at 100 sccm.
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.191 Torr (+0.27 Torr, about 9%) over 720 s.
Ar flow is steady at about 100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by more gas going in.
Temperature is stable at 750 °C and heater power is normal, so thermal control looks fine.
No O2 exhaust sensor is installed, so the tube atmosphere cannot be checked.

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 or a residual-gas reading would show whether air is getting in (seal leak) or the exhaust is restricted (blockage). Two other options: a rate-of-rise test with the flow stopped, or checking the pump/exhaust line conductance.
